This is an opportunity to grow within a global, product\-focused leader advancing the green transition, gaining deep exposure to IS‑Mill, Universal Journal, and end\-to\-end FI/CO integration—while collaborating with experienced colleagues across Europe in a supportive, learning\-centered environment. Do you want to build an SAP platform that accelerates NKT’s growth journey?
   

  

**Design and optimize CO‑PA in S/4HANA**
 In this role, you will translate complex finance and business requirements into robust CO‑PA and Margin Analysis designs, ensuring harmonized revenue, cost, and margin views for decision\-making. You will own operating concern structures, characteristics and value fields, derivation strategies, valuation logic, allocations, and settlement designs, while integrating with SD, MM, PP, and FI. You will safeguard closing processes, incident/problem resolution, and partner with BI/Analytics on data extraction and reporting models (e.g., BW/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud). * Your responsibility will be to:
* Design and configure operating concerns, characteristics, value fields, derivations, valuation, and settlements.
* Optimize account‑based CO‑PA and Margin Analysis (ACDOCA) with revenue recognition and cost flows.
* Define consistent profitability dimensions across customer, product, region, project, and contract.
* Manage allocations/assessments, top‑down distributions, and overhead costing transparency.

 Based in G3C Chennai within Group IT, reporting to the Senior Manager – IT. You will collaborate closely with FICO, BI/Analytics, architects, and global process owners across Europe. International travel for trainings may be required.
   

  

**Consultant Who Thrives On Global Collaboration**
 You are a curious, outcome‑oriented professional who enjoys turning financial and operational data into clear, business‑ready insights. You communicate complex CO‑PA concepts in simple terms and build trust with finance, business stakeholders, and IT partners. You lead tasks, work in distributed, multicultural teams, and manage multiple priorities with a structured, documentation‑first approach. A continuous‑improvement mindset helps you respectfully propose better profitability analytics, and follow through to implementation—always considering accessibility and the needs of people with different backgrounds, including persons with disabilities.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* 8\+ years SAP CO‑PA/Controlling experience, incl. S/4HANA account‑based CO‑PA/Margin Analysis.
* Designed and configured operating concerns, characteristics, value fields, derivations, valuation, settlements.
* Robust integration with SD billing, MM movements, PP orders, FI postings, and overhead accounting (cost centers, internal orders, WBS).

* Deep understanding of S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA) and implications for Margin Analysis and reporting.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-Consumer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.** 
**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation —from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.** 
**The team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
   

  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop the appropriate business models, technology operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future technology strategies


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (Consumer)**
* Following experience would be required: Experience in one or more subsectors, including Retail, Consumer Products, Airlines, Hotels, Restaurants, and/or Automotives
* Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience on either one or more of the following areas:
* Technology Strategy \& Alignment – Delivering Technology Strategy, driven both from a top\-down analysis starting with an articulated business strategy and a bottom\-up technology capability analysis; Experience working on cost reduction techniques, portfolio modernization and delivery roadmap creation within Consumer Industry
* Cloud Strategy – Understand the impact of cloud computing through hybrid cloud, data centers, cloud strategy in business and technology decisions, ability to identify and articulate the business and technology drivers of cloud computing across industries, design of business cases for cloud. Certifications such as AWS, GCP, Azure will be a plus. Experience with workload assessment, business cases development, operational assessment, roadmap creation, vendor selection for companies in Consumer space
* Technology Operating Model Design \- Assessment of current state operating model, ability to identify pain points and process gaps; design of target state operating model and associated roadmap for leading companies in Consumer Industry
* Enterprise Architecture – Experience of Enterprise Architecture capabilities such as Blueprinting, solution architecture, architecture assessment, planning and cost estimation. Knowledge of any of the major Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (preferred) E.g., TOGAF, FEA(F), and DoDAF.
* Technology Outsourcing \- Experience working on Technology Outsourcing model, vendor analysis and benchmarking, contract analysis and understanding of how IT resources create shareholder (business) value within Consumer Industry
* AI/ML – Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and frameworks, ability to design solutions around automation including advanced AI / ML solutions in areas of deep learning, machine learning, NLP, Simulation etc.; knowledge of AI/ML implementation use cases within Consumer Industry
* GenAI – Knowledge and experience in GenAI concepts, landscape (E.g., OpenAI, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, NVIDIA AI Foundations, GPT3 etc.) use cases across relevant industries and ability to assess GenAI fitment based on client demands within Consumer Industry
* DevOps / Agile – Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering with hands on experience on tools such as Jenkins, Git and JIRA
* Strong understanding of front\-to\-back architecture principles, technology stack, infrastructure with exposure to new age tools
* One life cycle project execution experience in recommending and/or implementing Technology strategy and solutions for improving business outcomes
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends including the associated technology implications within Consumer Industry
* Demonstrate application of business acumen while leveraging information technology
* Exposure to working in non\-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders


**Core Consulting**
* Communication: Ability to conduct client interviews, facilitate workshops and training sessions, and present findings and recommendations clearly and concisely
* Client Presence: Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and cross\-functional team members
* Analytical Thinking: Proficiency in quantitative analysis, primary and secondary research, and business case development; ability to synthesize data into actionable insights and recommendations. Strong command of analytical and productivity tools including Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (storyboarding, executive\-level presentations) is a plus
* Structured Problem Solving: Logical, hypothesis\-driven approach to problem solving with demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis
* Delivery Excellence: Deadline\-oriented and quality\-focused; capable of owning end\-to\-end delivery of high\-quality work products, managing workstreams, developing engagement plans, and mentoring junior team members
* Collaboration: Comfortable working independently and within teams across all levels; able to prioritize effectively, manage scope changes, handle multiple assignments simultaneously, and escalate issues proactively
* Networking: Self\-starter with the ability to navigate career growth and build a strong internal and external professional network


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA or MS from a Tier\-1 institution in India or abroad
* 3\-7 years of relevant post\-MBA/MS experience
* 2\-3 years of experience with a focus on the Consumer Industry


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. title: Senior Analyst – Treasury
description:
**About DESRI**
 DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market\-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11\.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 80 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, and Hyderabad (India).
   

  

 We are looking for a resourceful and driven professional to join DESRI, based out of the firm’s Hyderabad, India office. The successful candidate will be a part of a small, inclusive, highly skilled team responsible for supporting DESRI’s portfolio of wind, solar and battery projects in an agile environment that values collaboration, thoughtful problem solving, and attention to detail.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 You will work on a wide variety of Treasury and Corporate Finance initiatives, with a substantial focus on Treasury, managing our project\-level debt facilities, and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A).
   

  

 On the Treasury side, you will be responsible for coordinating and administering various cash payments and receipts on DESRI’s 80\+ solar and wind projects and financing corporate entities, while always ensuring the adequacy of funds. Additionally, you will work with various stakeholders, including bankers, investors, senior management, asset managers, and the accounting team, to ensure that the cash side of the business is functioning efficiently while continuously developing and implementing process improvements. Furthermore, you will be responsible for preparing periodic reports for the financing parties and senior management.
   

  

 On the FP\&A side, you will be responsible for forecasting DESRI’s short\-term and long\-term cash position, both at the project and corporate levels, tracking overall deal flow, planning for upcoming significant fundings, identifying and alleviating liquidity and covenant compliance concerns, and optimizing distributions. You will also potentially work on other areas of corporate finance, such as working with lenders, investors, counsel, and senior management on the initiation, modeling, due diligence, closing, and ongoing compliance of corporate financing facilities.
   

  

 Additionally, this position offers an opportunity to work on initiatives related to establishing, standardizing, optimizing, and documenting treasury processes, workflows, and controls.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate should hold –
   

  

* Education: Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance or a Chartered Accountant (CA) degree
* Experience: 2\-4 years in Treasury, Corporate Finance, FP\&A, or Accounting\-related functions
* Skills: Proficiency in cash flow modeling and forecasting; experience with Treasury management, debt facility administration, and FP\&A; ability to work with and enhance financial planning tools; strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; effective written and verbal communication skills; ability to develop strong partnerships and influence stakeholders across teams.
* Work Style: Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively with teams located across different time zones and jurisdictions.
* Preferred Qualifications: Prior experience in the renewable energy sector

 Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with more than $220 billion in assets under management. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value\-oriented, and risk\-controlled approach to investments in credit, equity, and real estate. The firm has more than 1,400 employees and offices in more than 25 cities worldwide.

**Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will be an integral member of the fund accounting team providing support to Oaktree’s Senior Loan strategy. The Fund Accounting Manager will supervise and execute tasks related to maintaining the books and records, reporting, and auditing for a diverse portfolio of investment funds, including open\-end funds, closed\-end funds, collateralized loan obligation portfolios (CLOs), and risk retention vehicles. This role will ensure compliance with international accounting standards and regulatory requirements, while facilitating communication with internal teams and external service providers, such as third\-party administrators, custodians, directors, legal and tax.
   

  

 Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following activities:
   

  

**Portfolio Oversight and Reconciliation:**
* Supervise the monthly and quarterly closing process, including pricing, management fee calculations, expense accruals, and portfolio activity reconciliation with custodial and counterparty records.
* Conduct daily cash and position reconciliations, resolve discrepancies with custodians, administrators, and counterparties, and address complex corporate actions.
* Ensure books and records accurately reflect purchase and sale transactions, trade par, and cash reconciliations for CLOs.


**Compliance and Reporting:**
* Prepare and review financial statements in compliance with U.S. and U.K. GAAP, IFRS, and investment company accounting rules (when applicable).
* Coordinate regulatory filings, including AIFMD Annex IV, Form PF, ADV reporting, CRS, and corporate tax reporting.
* Evaluate fund and client\-specific performance metrics (e.g., XIRR and TWR).


**Audit and Efficiency Execution:**
* Coordinate annual financial statement audits and fieldwork with external auditors.
* Support fund\-related automation and efficiency initiatives, ensuring adherence to Sarbanes\-Oxley compliance standards.


**Client Fund Activity Management:**
* Calculate income and expense allocations, update distribution waterfalls, and track cash forecasting for loan\-to\-value ratio and borrowing limits.
* Prepare borrowing notices and funding memos for corporate\-related activity.
* Manage fund openings, closings, client drawdowns, and distributions, ensuring smooth communication between stakeholders.


**Cash and Expense Analysis:**
* Support expense analysis, corporate expense reimbursement tracking, waterfall invoice preparation, and wire payment execution.
* Oversee corporate actions related to delayed compensation, cost of carry, amendment fees, and PIK interest amongst others.


**Support and Collaboration:**
* Monitor work performed by third\-party administrators and custodians, ensuring accuracy and quality control.
* Respond to ad\-hoc queries from client services and internal teams and implement setups for new funds and CLOs across accounting, marketing, performance, and trading systems.


**Experience Required**
* Minimum 2\-6 years relevant accounting or audit experience within Big Four public accounting or a mix of public accounting and investment management industry experience;
* Strong knowledge of reconciliation and account analysis;
* Excellent understanding of accounting and the ability to apply relevant investment company accounting rules;
* Solid analytical skills and ability to understand and resolve complex problems;
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word;
* Experience with Geneva and/or Geneva World Investor accounting systems is a plus;
* Experience with PowerBI, Alteryx, or other data analytical tools is a plus.
* Working knowledge of CLOs and Risk Retention Vehicles a plus, including:
* CLO lifecycle, including all aspects of the Warehouse Phase, Ramping of Portfolio, Pricing, Close, Drawdowns, Repayments, Day One S110 Test, 1st Loss Equity Tranche, Waterfall Schedule, Priority of Payments, Resets and Refinancing, Management and Incentive Fees, Par and Cash, Aggregate Principal/Collateral Balance Calculations

description:

 The Position
   

  

 Position Title: Lead/ Sr. Analyst – Business Research/ Market Intelligence

**Job Description**
 Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai/ Hyderabad to drive analytics \& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
   

  

 As a Lead Analyst, you will act as a dedicated SME to Roche’s global business partners. You will transcend traditional data collection by integrating Clinical and Commercial Competitive Intelligence (CI), Market intelligence with advanced GenAI\-driven analytics. Your goal is to provide high\-level strategic
   

  

 foresight using established business frameworks to influence Roche’s global product pipeline and commercial launch strategies.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

* Integrated Strategic Competitive/ Market Intelligence: Lead the end\-to\-end monitoring of the competitive landscape, bifurcating insights into Clinical CI (R\&D pipeline, trial design shifts, MoA breakthroughs) and Commercial CI (pricing, market access, field force shifts, and launch trajectories)
* Strategic Framework Application: Synthesize complex market signals into actionable strategies using structured frameworks such as SWOT, PESTLE, Porter’s Five Forces, and Patient Journey Mapping to identify unmet needs and white\-space opportunities
* GenAI \& Innovation: Architect and implement GenAI\-powered workflows (e.g., LLMs for rapid secondary research synthesis, automated earnings call sentiment analysis, or GPT\-based clinical trial summarization) to increase the velocity and depth of strategic recommendations
* High\-Stakes Conference Coverage (ASCO, ESMO, AACR, JP Morgan, Jefferies, etc.): Provide pre\-conference/ post\-conference impact assessment analysis of competitor data readouts on Roche’s portfolio
* Strategic Advisory: Transform market insights from public \& proprietary data sources (e.g. CT.gov, Clarivate, AlphaSense, EvaluatePharma) into "Executive Stories" that provide clear "So What?" and "Now What?" recommendations to partners \& senior leadership
* Predictive Intelligence: Flag "Trigger Events" (e.g., Breakthrough Designations, FDA/ regulatory signals, M\&A activity) and perform Scenario Planning to assess potential implications for Roche brands


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience: 5–8 years of experience in Strategic Business Research/ Market Research/ CI within Pharma/Life Sciences
* Methodology: Expert\-level proficiency in applying Business Research Frameworks (SWOT, PESTLE) to the pharmaceutical lifecycle—from Phase I to Loss of Exclusivity (LoE)
* Tech\-Savviness: Proven experience or a strong vision for using GenAI tools to automate data extraction and enhance strategic consulting
* Commercial Acumen: Deep understanding of the Drug Development Process, including clinical trial endpoints, regulatory pathways (FDA/EMA), and commercial launch excellence
* Communication: Ability to influence global stakeholders through structured communication and data visualization
* Self\-Driven Ownership: A proactive "self\-starter" who manages complex projects with minimal guidance in a fast\-paced global environment
* Innovative Problem\-Solver: Possesses an agile, GenAI\-forward mindset to reinvent research workflows and tackle intricate life science challenges
* Strategic Influencer: Passionate about the "why" behind the data, using structured narratives to move stakeholders from insights to action


 Education
   

  

* UG: B. Tech/B.E./B. Pharm
* PG (Preferred): MBA or Masters in Life Sciences/Biotechnology


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Internal Control Testing Senior Analyst
description:
**Job title** 
 : Internal Control Testing Senior Analyst
   

  

* Location: Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and
 **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by
 **making self\-care as simple as it should be** 
 . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our
 **100 loved brands** 
 , our
 **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** 
 and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

**B Corp certified in multiple markets** 
 , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 The Internal Control Testing Senior Analyst executes internal control testing activities across assigned entities and end\-to\-end processes, in line with approved methodology, test scripts, and sampling approaches. The role ensures high\-quality evidence, accurate documentation, and reliable conclusions in AuditBoard, and supports timely issue escalation and remediation follow\-up.
   

  

 As part of the Internal Control Testing and Automation organization based in Hyderabad, the Senior Analyst independently handles more complex and judgment\-heavy tests, supports walkthroughs with process stakeholders, and contributes to continuous improvement of testing practices through feedback on scripts, evidence requirements, and recurring issues.
   

  

 The role reports to the Director, Internal Control Testing and Automation and works in close coordination with process stakeholders and Internal Control Design \& Architecture (for control intent and test script guidance).
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
**Testing Execution \& Documentation**
* Execute control tests in accordance with approved test scripts, sampling methodology, and testing calendar (walkthroughs, sample selection, evidence review, and conclusions).
* Participate in walkthrough meetings and testing discussions with process owners and operational teams as instructed by Internal Control Design \& Architecture team.
* Execute complex or judgment\-heavy tests (e.g., manual journals, accrual reviews, key reconciliations) and synthesize outcomes for reviewer validation.
* Collect, review, and assess evidence from countries, hubs, and GBS teams; challenge completeness, accuracy, and appropriateness and request clarifications where required.
* Document test steps, results, and conclusions clearly and consistently in AuditBoard, ensuring a complete audit trail and proper evidence retention.


**Issue Identification \& Remediation Follow\-Up**
* Identify anomalies, inconsistencies, missing evidence, or potential control deficiencies during testing and escalate promptly with clear facts and supporting documentation.
* Contribute to root cause analysis by providing detailed observations, patterns, and context from testing execution.
* Support definition of practical and sustainable remediation actions in collaboration with process stakeholders and Internal Control Design \& Architecture.
* Track remediation progress, review closure evidence, and support re\-testing once remediation is implemented; update status and trackers in a timely manner.


**Controls Self\-Assessment (CSA) Support, Planning \& Readiness (during CSA periods)**
* Support CSA periods in coordination with Regional IC Leads by performing quality checks on selected CSA submissions (completeness, consistency, evidence readiness).
* Provide targeted evidence readiness guidance to Control Owners to improve quality of CSA outputs and reduce rework during testing campaigns.
* Support preparation of the upcoming testing cycle by consolidating lessons learned and contributing to scope proposals, entity prioritization, and readiness planning.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Support**
* Manage day\-to\-day interactions with Control Owners and operational teams to secure timely, high\-quality testing inputs and resolve routine testing queries.
* Provide feedback on test scripts, evidence expectations, and recurring issues to improve standardization and reduce rework across entities.
* Support testing campaigns through structured follow\-up and coordination as required (e.g., evidence tracking, reminders, completion monitoring).
* Contribute to testing automation and digitalization initiatives by providing requirements, validating outputs (UAT), and supporting adoption of automated exception reports and monitoring.
* Contribute to onboarding and knowledge sharing for testing standards, evidence expectations, and common deficiencies.


**About You**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
* Advanced degrees (MSc, MBA) or professional certifications (CA – India, CPA, ACCA, CIA) are an advantage.


**Experience**
* 3–6 years of experience in Internal Control, Audit, or risk assurance, preferably in a multinational environment.
* End\-to\-end control testing experience, including walkthroughs, sampling, evidence evaluation, and conclusion writing.
* Experience documenting testing in audit or GRC tools, AuditBoard preferred.
* Experience supporting remediation follow\-up, closure evidence review, and re\-testing cycles.
* Comfort working across time zones, with flexibility for occasional shifted hours during testing peaks.


**Skills**
* Evidence assessment and professional skepticism, able to identify inconsistencies and ask effective follow\-up questions.
* Documentation discipline, able to write clear, factual, and defensible conclusions.
* Planning and execution, able to manage multiple tests in parallel and meet deadlines.
* Stakeholder communication, concise written synthesis and effective follow\-ups with Control Owners.
* Tool proficiency, strong Excel and comfort working in GRC tools.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills


**Nice to Have**
* Experience supporting CSA reviews or evidence readiness activities.
* Exposure to data analytics, automated exception testing, or continuous monitoring concepts.
* Experience in GBS / shared services / CoE delivery models.
* Additional languages are a plus, especially French, Spanish, Japanese, or Mandarin.


**Why us?**
 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.
   

  

 www.opella.com/en/careers

**Role3: EMDCS Job Description**

* You will also provide technical guidance and support to other team members and collaborate with stakeholders across different functions and domains.
* Design and develop EDMCS applications, dimensions, hierarchies, properties, validations, subscriptions, and customizations
* Integrate EDMCS with other Oracle EPM Cloud and on\-premise applications such as Planning, Financial Consolidation and Close, Account Reconciliation, and Essbase.
* Perform data quality checks, data cleansing, data mapping, and data transformation using EDMCS and other tools.
* Configure and maintain security, access control, and audit policies for EDMCS applications and data.
* At least 7\+ years of experience in Oracle EPM Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS) with minimum 2 end to end implementation

* · Proven expertise in both Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching modules.
* · Strong experience configuring profiles, formats, reconciliation methods, matching rules, and auto\-match tolerances.
* · Skilled in loading balances via Data Management / EPM Integration Agent and managing data/import integrations.

title: EYP-RE-Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**VME Real Estate – Strategy and Transactions (SaT) – Assistant Manager Grade 2**
 Within SaT, Real Estate (RE) group is part of Valuations, Modelling and Economics sub\-service line. Our RE practice provides real estate valuation, analytical services and other business advisory services to developers, builders, investors, lenders and Fortune 500 companies.
   

  

 With over 500 RE professionals worldwide (\~35 in GDS RE), no similarly positioned global professional organization can match breadth of our capabilities or depth of our resources. GDS RE works as a strategic partner to global RE practices, working with them to provide highly efficient and value\-added services to meet our clients’ real estate valuation and diligence requirements.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Assistant Manager with expertise in real estate valuation to join the valuation group of our Real Estate Valuation Team.
   

  

 As a member of the Ernst \& Young Real Estate team, the Assistant Manager will serve as a project lead and/or member of multiple client engagement teams around the world (US, UK, Germany, Australia etc) which primarily assist in real estate and hospitality advisory engagements in a fast\-paced, service\-oriented business environment. Assistant Manager will work on a wide variety of real estate and hospitality\-specific clients including owners, developers, builders, financial institutions, lenders, pension funds, as well as numerous Fortune 500 companies.
   

  

 Typical engagements include appraisals and valuations, review of valuation analysis, market studies/research, cash flow analyses, due diligence, portfolio analysis and cash flow modelling.
   

  

 This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a valuation service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Serve as a member of multiple client engagement teams, taking a lead role in understanding clients’ needs, conducting analyses and reporting results
* Work on and manage engagements on real estate advisory, valuation and due diligence, spread across property types
* Engagements include financial analyses, cash flow modeling, analytical model reviews, property/portfolio modeling, asset valuations, real estate appraisals and appraisal reviews, and other general real estate advisory services.
* We are involved in analysis of a variety of property types including multi\-family residential, office, retail, hotel, industrial, mixed\-use, infrastructure, and special\-use properties.
* Specific engagement responsibilities will include financial and cash flow modeling, market information research, real estate documents analysis (including site/building plans, leases, appraisals, and mortgage underwriting/lending documents), market studies, asset valuation (PPA/fair value), and report writing
* Maintain and develop positive, productive, and professional relationships with EY offices globally
* Supervise, develop and mentor professionals at the Staff and Senior level
* Ability to manage and counsel a team of 1\-2 professionals if given opportunity
* Demonstrate teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
* Use current technology and tools to enhance the effectiveness of services provided.
* Performing any other task or ad hoc projects as requested.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong knowledge in performing valuation of Real \& Intangible assets using Income Approach (Discounted Cash Flow Method \& Direct Capitalization Method), Net Asset Value Method (or Cost Method) and Precedent Transaction Analysis (or Relative Valuation/ Sales Comparison/ Market Approach)
* Knowledge of developing valuation models, performing highest and best use valuation analysis for purposes of financial reporting, tax planning etc.
* Proficient at using research databases like LoopNet, REIS, RCA (real capital analytics), CoStar, CBRE, JLL, C\&W, Capital IQ, One Source, Factiva, Reuters, etc.
* Analyzing financial statements, conducting market research studies and preparing reports, Application of Free Cash Flows, Terminal value, Discount rate, WACC, Advanced MS Excel models etc.
* Strong knowledge of key clauses in lease (options, economic terms, terminations)
* Excellent analytical, project management, communication, interpersonal and teaming skills
* Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary
* Actively promote the sharing of knowledge within the group; Contribute pro\-actively to building team spirit
* Manage and responsible for 1\-2 people for their career progression, learning and development etc
* Exposure to tools like Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx etc. will be added advantage


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Master’s in business administration (MBA) specialize in Finance
* 5\+ years of direct work experience in real estate valuation projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Experience with BIG4 accounting firm would be provided weightage


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* People management skills
* Project management skills
* Exposure to tools like Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx etc. will be added advantage


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-M&A-Senior Consultant-I&DFin
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- Mergers \& Acquisition – I\&D Fin \- Senior Consultant**
 Join our team of Strategy \& Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M\&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Senior Consultant or equivalent
   

  

 As an experienced Sr. Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 We guide M\&A initiatives for companies to help expand and accelerate revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model, or capital model. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Develop client deliverables and documentations
* Identify and select the most relevant set of tools/techniques to meet client requirements such as business case development, financial modeling, and analysis, etc.
* Analyze and interpret project data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations based on the result of the specific outputs.
* Use analytics to build strategic insights for the client.
* Define project standards, methodologies, and execute process improvement initiatives
* Engage in client interaction:
* Conduct client interviews to verify and validate assumptions, hypothesis, and analysis.
* Participate in workshops and training sessions.
* Synthesize and present insights and recommendations.
* Develop and maintain working relationships with client counterparts.
* Participate in engagement management including:
* Own and manage specific work threads.
* Develop plans for components of engagements.
* Coordinate activities between different work threads.
* Identify and help manage changes in scope.
* Manage and mentor junior resources.


**The Team:**
 The M\&A team bring deep industry experience, rigorous analytical capabilities, and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients' most complex business problems. Our operational capabilities address the unique issues faced by manufacturing organizations, service businesses and infrastructure operations. These are combined with capabilities in finance, performance management and business restructuring. Our teams take the lead on delivering all aspects of the people side of transactions to our clients. We leverage commercial awareness and professional expertise, along with using the skills and expertise of others, to deliver the best possible experience and outcomes for our clients.
   

  

 Capabilities of an M\&A I\&D Finance \& Supply Chain practitioner will include the following:
   

  

* Advising clients on separating/carving out a business unit for divestiture and integrating newly acquired target with buyer’s organization with focus on the Finance and / or Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) workstreams.
* Preparing for Day\-One (legal ownership transfer) / Day\-Two (focus shifts from deal execution to operational transition / TSA exit) planning, business continuity planning, synergy identification / capture and commercial/ operational due diligence with focus on Finance and / or Operations workstreams.
* Preparing and executing Legal Entity Readiness, Finance Function / Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) Integration \& Carve\-Out, Transformation planning, Contracts review, Sourcing Strategy Revamp.
* Mapping and documenting current state and future state processes with a focus on Finance Operating Model and / or Operations Operating Model.
* Understanding the end\-to\-end finance processes such as Order\-to\-Cash, Record\-to\-Report, Procure\-to\-Pay, Close\-Consolidate, Taxation etc.
* Conducting contract metadata extraction, contract separation, supplier negotiation Support, operational benchmarking, supply chain ops cost baselining etc.
* Analyzing financial statements and large financial and non\-financial data sets.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Masters in Business Administration
* Masters Degree in Actuarial
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience for Sr. Consultants


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Consulting Background
* M\&A advisory experience
* Program/Project Management office experience
* Investment banking experience on the sell/ buy side
* Industry M\&A strategy experience
* Specific functional knowledge in areas of Finance, Operations, Procurement etc.
* Demonstrated experience in financial statement and operations analytics


**Education:** 
 MBA or Master’s Degree (Actuarial)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune

title: Analyst — FP&A
description:
Analyst — FP\&A \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  
 



 Build and hold the models a real assets platform forecasts on — development appraisals, project cash flows, rent rolls, debt schedules — and learn from the Financial Controller how a number becomes a decision. Modelling as a craft, not a skill.
 



  
 



 A note before you read on. The team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity described in this brief reflect the platform's current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation and incentive structures are confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  
 



 REPORTS TO: Financial Controller — Head of FP\&A \& Asset Management · EXPERIENCE: 2–5 years in financial modelling, FP\&A or transaction analysis, in or around real estate
 



  
 



 ABOUT VANTROCK
 



 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth.
 



 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  
 



 THE FINANCE \& ACCOUNTS TEAM
 



 Vantrock keeps its books in\-house. The finance function owns every number from the site to the board.
 



 Twenty\-one seats when fully built; sixteen live now, one of them already filled. Small enough that every person in it is known by name to the founder; large enough to run a platform properly. Every seat in the team is a builder's seat: the function does not exist yet in the form described here, and the people who join it now are the ones who will decide what it becomes.
 



  
 



 THE MODEL IS THE TOOL; THE FORECAST IS THE PRODUCT
 



 Vantrock separates the two things a finance function does with a number. The accounts team records what happened. The FP\&A and Asset Management team — the Financial Controller and this seat — says what will happen and raises a hand early when the two drift apart. Every asset against the underwriting it was bought on. Every construction budget against its bill of quantities. Every lease against the rent roll it was modelled at. Every procurement decision priced before it is made.
 



  
 



 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



 The Financial Controller's seat is forecasting, red\-flagging and the Asset Review — and it cannot be done alone. The models have to be built, refreshed, reconciled to the books and stress\-tested every month, for a pipeline of 10 million sq ft across four cities and a set of strategies queued behind the first. This seat does that work, and is the seat from which the platform intends to grow the next Financial Controller.
 



  
 



 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 1\. The models. Development appraisals, project cash flows, lease\-up and rent\-roll models, debt schedules, exit models — built to the platform's standard, documented, version\-controlled, and reconciled to the ledger every month.
 



 2\. The rolling forecast, mechanics. The monthly refresh for the platform and every project entity — actuals pulled from the books, assumptions updated with the project, leasing and procurement teams, variances computed and listed for the Financial Controller's review.
 



 3\. The Asset Review pack, first draft. Every asset's page — actuals against underwriting, cost against budget, the triggers — assembled from the dashboards and the models for the Financial Controller to finish and present.
 



 4\. Variance analysis. Every material variance traced to its cause and written up in two lines before it reaches the Financial Controller — not discovered in the meeting.
 



 5\. The founder's question. The ad\-hoc analysis — what does this lease do to the exit, what does this contractor's variation do to cost\-to\-complete — turned around the same day, correctly.
 



 6\. The operating layer. Models and trackers live on the platform's dashboards, not in a private spreadsheet.
 



  
 



 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 ESSENTIAL
 



 – 2–5 years in financial modelling, FP\&A or transaction analysis, at a real estate developer, an investor, a lender's real estate team, a consultancy serving real estate, or a fund.
 



 – Modelling as a craft. You have built a development appraisal or a project cash\-flow model from a blank sheet — not modified a template — and you can explain every assumption in it. This will be tested in a case.
 



 – Accounting literacy: you can read a trial balance, tie a model to a ledger and know why the two disagree.
 



 – Excel at an expert level, and fluency with at least one of the modern tools around it — Python, SQL, a BI layer, or the platform's own dashboards.
 



 – Precise, fast and honest about uncertainty. You say "I don't know" before you guess.
 



 – A Chartered Accountant, or an MBA in Finance. Either. An MBA from a second\-tier institution with three years of the right modelling outranks a first\-tier degree with none.
 



 – Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, or relocating before joining.
 



 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



 – Not an investment\-banking analyst seat. The models here are held for years and reconciled monthly; they are not built for a pitch and forgotten.
 



 – Not a reporting seat. You build and analyse; the dashboards report.
 



 – Not a seat for someone who wants to be told what to model. The Financial Controller will set the question; finding the right model is your job.
 



  
 



 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



 – The books are in\-house. You reconcile your models to a ledger kept twenty feet away, every month.
 



 – Everything runs on the platform's dashboards. No private spreadsheets; every model has a home, a version and an owner.
 



 – Judgment is written down. Every assumption has a source; every variance has a two\-line cause.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, with occasional site visits.
 



  
 



 COMPENSATION
 



 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely.
 



 Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus, and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives as the seat grows — priced to the seat and confirmed in the offer.
 



  
 



 CULTURAL FIT
 



 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat. You work fluently with AI tools for research, modelling, drafting and analysis, and you build on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test is part of the process for every seat, at every level of seniority, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second standing requirement. The books are ours, but auditors, banks, the fund administrator, valuers, law firms and system vendors are commanded by this team — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to. We hire for judgment and accountability.
 



  
 



 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 



 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days. It carries two links: a fixed set of six questions answered by AI interview — about forty minutes, and the first work sample; we review it before the CV — and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there:
 



 1\. The Model conversation. The best model you have built from a blank sheet: what it decided, what it got wrong, what you would change. With the Financial Controller.
 



 2\. A 90\-minute supervised case. A data pack for a warehousing development — land, approvals timeline, construction budget, a pre\-lease term sheet, a facility term sheet — from which you build the project cash flow, compute three headline outputs, and state the three assumptions you are least sure of. Reviewed with the Financial Controller and the CFO — or the Founder \& CEO until the CFO is in seat.
 



 3\. References. One or two former reporting managers, contacted directly.
 



 Once we have received your application, your AI interview and your test, we will reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  
 



 TO APPLY
 



 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "Analyst — FP\&A — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. This is mandatory — a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application; we will read your LinkedIn as well.
 



 – One model you built from a blank sheet — anonymised as needed — with three sentences on what was hard about it. A screenshot is not a model; send the file or a link to it.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to see to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the assumption in a development appraisal that most often turns out wrong, and how you would build the model so that being wrong about it is visible early. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read everything that arrives with a model and a paragraph — properly, not skimmed. If this sounds like your seat, write to us.
 



  
 



 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 




 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock

title: Capital Markets Associate - Real Estate
description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–8 years, with hands\-on US commercial real estate debt experience required
   

  

**Working hours:** 
 Minimum 6\-hour daily overlap with US Central Time
   

  

**Compensation:** 
 ₹300,000–470,000/month, based on depth of direct US CRE debt experience
   

  

**Start:** 
 Immediate or within 30 days
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Sanctuary is building something most real estate companies aren't even trying to build: wellness\-focused, nature\-integrated home communities across the Texas Hill Country, designed around the idea that where you live should make you healthier, calmer, and more connected. And now we're scaling the capital engine behind it.
   

  

 This is a company in build mode. You'd be joining early enough to shape how we finance growth for years to come, not stepping into a process that's already set in stone.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We're hiring an Associate to structure and execute debt for our US real estate portfolio \- construction, bridge, and permanent financing across multifamily, commercial, and ground\-up development. This is not a corporate credit, project finance, or loan servicing role: every transaction you'll work on is tied to a specific US property, and you'll be underwriting, structuring, and negotiating real loans against real collateral, not modeling hypotheticals.
   

  

 You'll report directly to the Capital Lead and work closely with our CEO to determine how we finance and scale our real estate pipeline.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Deal structuring \& execution: Underwrite and structure construction, bridge, and mezzanine financing for specific US assets. Take term sheets apart and put them back together to win on pricing, leverage, and flexibility.
* Capital modeling: Build the models that drive real decisions — DSCR, LTV, LTC, IRR, debt yield, stress\-tested against rate moves, lease\-up delays, cost overruns.
* Capital stack strategy: Recommend how we fund specific projects, balancing cost of capital against risk and timeline.
* Lender relations \& syndication: Be a real point of contact for US lenders and institutional capital partners. Run the diligence process and drive facilities to close.
* Portfolio surveillance: Own the debt maturity ladder across the portfolio and keep every DSCR, LTV, and LTC covenant in view before it becomes a problem.


**What You Bring**
* 3–8 years in real estate capital markets, real estate private equity, CRE lending, or real estate investment banking.
* A specific US commercial real estate deal you can walk us through in detail, the property, the structure, the numbers you calculated, and why.
* Excel and Google sheets mastery, including built debt waterfalls; VBA or Power Query is a strong plus.
* Real working knowledge of US credit agreements, loan documentation, and institutional underwriting standards for real estate.
* The ability to turn dense underwriting into a memo an executive can act on in five minutes.
* Minimum 6\-hour daily overlap with US Central Time.


**Not the right fit if:** 
 your background is loan servicing, reconciliation, back\-office operations, or ratings/research without direct property\-level underwriting. We'd rather point you toward a role that's a better match than waste your time or ours.
   

  

**Why join now**
* Real stakes, real speed. You're not modeling hypotheticals \- you're advising directly on how we move millions of dollars to build communities that are already going up.
* A seat at the table. Direct exposure to senior leadership and the institutional lenders who fund our growth.
* Build the function, not just the deals. We don't have a Senior Capital Markets hire yet \- you'd be the first person to lay the groundwork for how this function works at Sanctuary.
* Total ownership. We hand you real runway to improve how we underwrite and close, not a script to follow.
* Mission you can feel. You're financing homes designed to make people's lives measurably better \-v not another spec subdivision.

 Join our team of Strategy \& Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M\&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

**Level: Senior or equivalent**
 As a Senior at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for reviewing the valuation analysis/ models assisting client with their taxation planning and compliance; financial reporting in accordance with ‘US GAAP’ or ‘IFRS’ accounting standards . You will build, review, and validate quantitative models, interpret outputs in the context of applicable accounting standards, and draft client\-ready deliverables. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**The team:**
 The Complex Securities Valuation team, part of Deloitte Consulting Services, provides services relating to the full life cycle of Valuation, including policy and process assessments, and quantitative solutions to support the valuation of all types of financial instruments under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, ASC 842 and other financial reporting standards including complex derivatives, convertible securities, contingent consideration, contingent claims analysis, stock compensation, incremental borrowing rates, equity securities and other investment products. Valuation service offering also provides advisory services to financial institutions, governmental agencies and other private and public companies.
   

  

**Work you’ll do / Key Responsibilities:**
 The key job responsibilities will be to:
   

  

* Conduct 409A common stock valuations and complex capital structure analyses using OPM (Black\-Scholes and Monte Carlo), PWERM, and hybrid methodologies; document DLOM/DLOC assumptions with appropriate support
* Apply and document fair value measurement methodologies under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, and ASC 842; ensure deliverables are defensible to external auditors
* Support Deloitte US and Deloitte India (Offices of the US) project teams in providing financial consulting services relating to preparing and auditing complex security valuations. Assist in the valuation of financial instruments for regulatory, financial, and 409A purposes.
* Create/assist in creating financial models, analyzing financial statements, conducting industry research, and writing reports
* Draft client\-ready valuation reports and memos including methodology rationale, model assumptions, sensitivity analyses, and concluded fair values; respond substantively to auditor and client review comments
* Deliver high\-quality valuation work products and assist other team members in India (Offices of the US), when required; and interact with internal clients and communicate with stakeholders in the US
* Supervise and review work of junior analysts; provide structured, technical feedback to build team capability and maintain quality standards across the engagement portfolio
* May need to work on other Deloitte Consulting engagements
* Support business development through proposal preparation, pitch materials, and thought leadership on emerging topics in financial instrument valuation


**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Strong background in mathematical finance at the Master's level \- degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, or a related technical discipline.
* Understanding financial valuation concepts is required. Applicants are expected to have strong analytical and computer skills. Quantitative analysis technical skills and experience with modeling and valuation theory (Monte\-Carlo Simulations, Binomial Lattice, Black Scholes, Options Theory, Geometric Brownian Motion), and tools (Bloomberg, and S\&P Capital IQ) are a plus.
* 4\-8 years of relevant Complex Securities Valuation experience


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* CFA Level II cleared or appeared
* Ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse client contacts
* Conceptual and quantitative depth in valuation methodologies and concepts and underlying markets and models.


**Education:**
* Master's level \- degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, Business Administration in Finance

title: Senior Manager - Capital Formation (Investments/Equity Fundraising)
description:
**About Enfinity Global** 




 Enfinity Global is a purpose\-driven company focused on making a positive impact on the planet by helping companies, governments, and individuals transition to a carbon\-free and sustainable economy. Founded in 2019, Enfinity develops, finances, builds, owns, and operates renewable energy and energy storage projects across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, leveraging a vertically integrated model that drives sustainable power deployment at scale. Today the company's global portfolio spans over :39 GW of renewable energy and storage projects, with a significant footprint in solar, wind, and battery energy storage systems, and has attracted multiple billions in investment to support its growth.
 



 Enfinity India is a strategic and expanding regional platform focused on utility\-scale renewable energy. The company has over 4 GW of development pipeline for solar and wind projects across several Indian states, and continues to expand its development pipeline and capital partnerships to support India's energy transition goals
 



 Enfinity has offices in the USA, Spain, Italy, UK, Netherlands, India, and Japan. Our team of over 400 Enfiniters comprises seasoned finance professionals, as well as experienced project developers and operators with extensive industry experience across all stages of the project life cycle. We pride ourselves on being creative and innovative solution providers to our customers and partners.
 



**Role Overview** 




 Enfinity India is looking for a high\-calibre finance professional to work on equity and structured capital transactions across its renewable energy platform.
 



 This role offers direct exposure to equity, structured equity, and mezzanine transactions at both asset and platform level. The selected candidate will work closely with the Head of Capital Formation, India and be actively involved in deal structuring, investor negotiations, financial modelling, and transaction closure. This is a front\-end transaction execution role in a fast\-scaling renewable energy platform.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Equity \& Structured Capital Execution** 



* Support execution of platform level and asset\-level equity raises
* Assist in structuring and evaluating transactions including: Minority / majority stake sales, Joint ventures and Structured equity\-instruments
* Mezzanine financing
* Analyze capital structure strategies to optimize return, leverage, and risk allocation



**Transaction Management** 



* Support end\-to\-end deal lifecycle: investor outreach to financial close
* Prepare teasers, Information Memoranda, management presentations, and IC materials
* Coordinate with legal, financial, tax, and technical advisors during diligence and documentation
* Support commercial negotiations and term sheet discussions
* Track transaction milestones and drive closure timelines



**Financial Modelling \& Valuation** 



* Build and manage advanced project and platform\-level financial models
* Conduct valuation analysis (DCF, IRR, sensitivity, and scenario modeling)
* Evaluate transaction accretion/dilution, LTV impact, and return profiles



**Investor Interface** 



* Engage with infrastructure funds, private equity investors, and strategic partners
* Manage data rooms Q\&A process, and investor diligence requirements
* Support relationship development with institutional capital providers


**Requirements**

**Experience (6\-7 Years)** 



* Mandatory end to end equity fundraise transaction experience
* Big 4 Advisory Transaction
* Corporate Finance in Renewable Energy / Infrastructure
* Demonstrated experience in deals execution and closures



**Technical Strength** 



* Strong corporate finance and capital structuring fundamentals
* Advanced Excel\-based financial modelling capability
* Strong valuation and investment analysis skills
* High\-quality PowerPoint and investor communication ability



**Preferred** 



* Renewable energy / infrastructure transaction exposure
* MBA (Finance) from reputed institute
* CFA (completed or pursuing)



**What This Role Offers** 



* Direct exposure to equity and structured capital markets
* Front\-end transaction experience in a high\-growth renewable platform
* Interaction with global infrastructure and PE investors
* High visibility within a lean capital formation team



 In Enfinity Global, you will find a dynamic and supportive environment, contributing to one of the most impactful industries. We are committed to fostering your professional and personal growth while providing you the chance to make a real impact on climate change.
 



 Let's build our future together.
 



 Visit www.enfinity.global  to discover more about our culture and values.

title: Project Finance Analyst
description:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 The Project Finance Analyst is responsible for supporting the financial management, reporting, forecasting, and analysis of assigned projects throughout the project lifecycle. This role partners closely with Project Managers, Project Controls, Accounting, Treasury, and Tax to ensure accurate project financial records, timely forecasts, effective cash management, contract compliance, and clear financial insights that support project execution and business decision\-making.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Support the financial management of assigned projects across the full project lifecycle, including project setup, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, billing, cash flow tracking, and closeout.
* Partner with Project Managers and Project Controls to monitor project performance, analyze cost trends, evaluate risks and opportunities, and provide timely financial insights to support decision\-making.
* Review contract terms to understand billing requirements, payment milestones, revenue recognition considerations, currencies, tax implications, financial instruments, and other project\-specific financial obligations.
* Prepare and maintain project forecasts, including gross profit, cost\-to\-complete, cash flow, receipts and disbursements, and variance analysis against prior forecasts, budgets, and actual results.
* Analyze project financial results and provide commentary on gross margin, forecast changes, project investment balances, receivables, contract capital, and key drivers impacting project profitability.
* Prepare project billings and support collection activities in accordance with contractual terms, working with Project Managers, Treasury, and Accounting to resolve billing or cash collection issues.
* Maintain accurate project financial records, reconcile project sub\-ledgers to the general ledger, and ensure financial system data is complete, timely, and aligned with internal controls.
* Coordinate with Treasury and Tax on project\-related cash flow, bank guarantees, letters of credit, withholding taxes, duties, tax receipts, and other domestic or international project finance matters.
* Support proposal and contract reviews by evaluating payment terms, pricing, currencies, escalation provisions, financial risk, and revenue recognition considerations.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen reporting accuracy, forecasting discipline, project controls, and overall financial visibility across assigned projects.


**Monthly** 
**Close and Reporting** 
**Responsibilities**
* Prepare assigned projects for monthly close, ensuring project costs, billings, accruals, intercompany activity, foreign exchange adjustments, and bank transactions are recorded accurately and on time.
* Identify, prepare, and support project\-related journal entries, including accruals, warranty/client support costs, cost transfers, and other required project adjustments.
* Reconcile project financial reports, sub\-ledgers, and trial balance activity to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with accounting policies.
* Prepare monthly reporting packages and financial commentary for assigned projects, including actual\-to\-forecast variances, gross profit movement, cash flow updates, and risks or opportunities.
* Monitor intercompany balances by project and coordinate with project teams and finance stakeholders to resolve out\-of\-balance items and ensure matching activity is properly recorded.
* Ensure financial analyses and supporting documentation are uploaded to the appropriate document management systems in accordance with established deadlines and quality standards.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's/CMA degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field required.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in project finance, project accounting, financial analysis, cost control, contract accounting, or a related finance role.
* Experience supporting project\-based businesses, preferably in engineering, technology, energy, petrochemical, construction, EPC, or industrial services environments.
* Strong understanding of project forecasting, cost\-to\-complete analysis, gross margin analysis, cash flow forecasting, billing, accruals, and revenue recognition concepts.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and financial modeling skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
* Ability to partner effectively with Project Managers, Project Controls, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
* High degree of professional integrity, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial systems; experience with JD Edwards, Hyperion, or similar ERP/EPM systems is preferred.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.
   

  

**Lummus Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** 
 We value diversity and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected characteristic under applicable law. Applicant information will be processed in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection laws.

title: Manager/ Senior Manager- Business Finance
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We train India's next Allied Healthcare Professionals and we need someone who is a highly analytical and business\-oriented
 **Business Finance professional (Leadership Role) who treats each campus like their own company, not just a row in a spreadsheet and can drive financial performance through data\-driven insights and strategic decision\-making** 
 . This is not a traditional accounting or controllership role. This is for someone who wants to be in the room where growth, admissions, and campus operations decisions are made; bringing the financial lens that turns good intentions into profitable outcomes.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Most finance people explain the P\&L after the quarter ends. We want someone who changes it before it does. If you've ever sat in a business meeting thinking "I could've told you that three weeks ago", this is your seat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 ● Run the numbers behind real campuses, enrollments, faculty costs, placements, profitability. Know them cold.
 



 ● Be in the room, not the report; sit with Business Heads and speak up before decisions are made, not just summarize them after.
 



 ● Chase the "why" behind the money; why did this channel's cost\-per\-enrollment spike? Why is one campus profitable and a near\-identical one isn't?
 



 ● Follow the cash all the way home from student loan approval to actual money in the bank.
 



 ● Build the model before anyone asks for it; forecasts, business cases, what\-ifs are rooted in real batch sizes and seat fill rates, not last year's numbers with 15% added on.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 ● 5 to 10 years in FP\&A or business finance; bonus if it's EdTech, healthtech, FinTech, or another fast\-moving, multi\-location business
 



 ● You've worked with business teams, not just for them
 



 ● Excel/Sheets fluent; SQL or BI tools a bonus
 



 ● You can explain a complex model in one sentence a non\-finance person gets instantly
 



 ● Curious by default; you ask "why" before you build the spreadsheet
 



 ● Confident enough to challenge a decision with data, even without authority over the room
 



  





**Bonus Points.** 




 ● CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA. Startup scars preferred over big\-company polish.
 



  





**Winning Looks Like** 




 ● Six months in, a Business Head calls you before making a big call, not after. And you can point to one real number you moved.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

 3–5 years in costing/cost accounting, preferably in a chemical, polymer, or manufacturing industry

**Title: Finance Executive (US Accounting)**
