**Location: Gurgaon** 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 




  





**QuickBooks experience is mandatory;** 
 Tally ERP knowledge is preferred.
 



  




* **Accounts Payable \& Receivable:** 
  Manage end\-to\-end AP/AR operations, including invoice processing, verification, payment coordination, vendor reconciliations, and timely ledger updates.
* **Book\-keeping \& Accounting:** 
 Maintain accurate books of accounts, record journal and provision entries, manage prepaid expenses, and ensure proper classification and documentation of financial transactions.
* **Bank \& Account Reconciliation:** 
  Perform regular bank reconciliations and account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure all transactions are accurately reflected in the books.

 Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, P\&L reports, MIS reports, and budget vs. actual variance analysis.

 Hands\-on experience with QuickBooks (Mandatory) and Tally ERP for accounting, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, AP/AR, reconciliations, GST, and TDS.

* Working knowledge of MS Word and other Microsoft Office tools.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and ability to identify and resolve financial discrepancies.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounting activities and deadlines.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and accuracy while handling sensitive financial information.

 We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**

You will assist in preparing indirect tax returns, performing VAT accounting and balance sheet reconciliations, supporting tax audits and registrations, and ensuring timely completion of compliance obligations.
   

  

 You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, finance teams, and external service providers across multiple jurisdictions to gather and validate tax data. You will also contribute to process improvement initiatives, support automation opportunities, and leverage technology and AI\-enabled solutions to enhance efficiency, controls, and reporting outcomes.

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a dynamic global environment.


 We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
 At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
   

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company\-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role

Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.

title: FS - RC - Actuarial - Pension - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
**Staff, P\&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
   

  

 Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on\-the\-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
   

  

 Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
   

  

**On engagements, you will:**
* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members


**Within the actuarial practice you will:**
* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 1\+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)


**What We Look For**
* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Create and maintain early-warning indicators for supplier performance and delivery risk. Drive weekly risk reviews with clear escalations, dependency management, and decision logs. Recommend systemic fixes that reduce repeat delay patterns and improve planning reliability. 4. Collaboration and Capability Building Partner with product and technology teams to design, test, and deploy process improvements. title: Senior Manager  Corporate Finance
description:
Position 
 Senior Manager Corporate Finance Department 
 Corporate Finance Location 
 Chennai Corporate Office Reports To 
 General Manager Corporate Finance Experience 
 5 to 8 years post qualification Qualification 
 CA / CMA mandatory; MBA Finance preferred 
 ABOUT THE ROLE Pricing, payer contracting and revenue governance at Apollo have largely been managed at the unit level. The group is now bringing these areas under a common corporate framework, and this position is responsible for building that framework and implementing it across the network. 
 Driving technology building and implementation is part of this role. The position works closely with the Technology team to co create and implement solutions at group level that will carry the pricing, contracting and commercial governance processes. 
 The position works closely with the General Manager to build the function, with a team added as the mandate scales. The initial period is hands on, and the work carries direct visibility to the CFO office. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Pricing and Tariff Governance Own the group pricing policy, and maintain version control of tariffs across specialities, service lines and units. Run the annual tariff revision cycle, including the revision model, cost inflation and case mix scenarios, and recommendations with quantified P&L impact. Build and maintain the package and procedure rate library, including package costing and floor prices. Review exception and non standard pricing requests within delegated authority, and escalate with a recommendation. 
 2. Revenue and Commercial Analytics Develop the group view of payer economics covering realisation, discounts and net yield by payer, plan, unit and speciality. Build service line and speciality profitability analytics, including contribution margin, ARPOB, ALOS and case mix. Identify and quantify revenue leakage across unbilled charges, off policy discounts, tariff mapping errors and claim deductions, and follow through on recovery. Prepare pricing models and business cases for new services, capacity additions and equipment proposals, along with competitor benchmarking. Publish the monthly commercial MIS pack for leadership review. 
 3. Payer and Institutional Commercials Maintain the central repository and commercial evaluation of insurer, TPA, corporate and government scheme arrangements, covering rates, terms, exclusions and the renewal calendar. Prepare the commercial case for renewals, including rate benchmarking, volume and margin analysis and deduction history, and participate in negotiations. Monitor contract performance after signature, covering realisation against contracted rates, deduction and denial trends, pre authorisation turnaround and receivable ageing. Standardise commercial terms across the network in coordination with Legal. 
 4. Technology, Systems and Master Data Drive the building and implementation of technology solutions for the function, working with the Technology team from design through to rollout at group level. Co create the solution by translating commercial and governance requirements into system requirements, and remain the finance owner through build, testing and go live. Ensure pricing, contracting and commercial governance processes are carried on system rather than run outside it, including the necessary integration with HIS, ERP and billing. Define and maintain the commercial master data standard for service, tariff, payer and package masters, along with the change control process. Drive adoption across units, and automate recurring analytics and reporting in Power BI or an equivalent tool. 
 CANDIDATE PROFILE Qualification and experience Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant. MBA in Finance preferred. 5 to 8 years of post qualification experience in corporate or commercial finance, FP&A, business finance, pricing or revenue management. Hands on experience in one or more of pricing, contracting, profitability analysis or revenue assurance, with scope that has grown over time. Candidates who have supported these areas and are ready to take ownership will be considered. Experience of working with technology teams to build or implement a system, including defining requirements and testing. Experience in multi location or multi entity organisations is an advantage. Healthcare, diagnostics or insurance and TPA sector experience is preferred but not essential. Technical skills Advanced Excel and financial modelling. This is the core requirement. Exposure to Power BI or an equivalent business intelligence tool, and to SAP or Oracle ERP. Familiarity with hospital information systems and the hospital revenue cycle is an advantage. Working understanding of data structures, master data management and system workflows. Competencies Willingness to set up processes and controls where practice is not yet standardised. Ability to translate a commercial requirement into a system requirement and see it through with a technology team. Effective engagement with unit finance teams, operations, technology and senior leadership without direct reporting authority. Sound commercial judgement, attention to detail and strong execution across concurrent priorities. Clear written and verbal communication, including at leadership forums.

Key Skills: Power BI,Commercial Finance,Corporate Finance,Business Finance,Pricing,SAP,Finance Transformation,Revenue Analytics

 Deloitte USI Consulting Services is looking for Workday Finance \& Supply Chain functional professionals with proven hands\-on experience in at least one full ERP implementation project.
   

  

****Summary****
 As a Workday practitioner at Deloitte USI Consulting Services, you will design, configure, and deploy enterprise\-scale Workday solutions, collaborating with cross\-functional and global teams to translate client business requirements into effective functional designs and deliverables. You will independently manage your workstream responsibilities while guiding and mentoring junior team members, bringing structure and expertise to every stage of the engagement. Your role spans the full project lifecycle — from estimation and planning through execution and post go\-live support — ensuring high\-quality, timely delivery of solutions that meet client needs and project standards.
   

  

**Work You’ll do**
 You will play a key role in ensuring the successful implementation of Workday Finance \& Supply Chain Management project, engaging across all project stages — requirements gathering, solution design through post go\-live support. In this role, you will analyze client business requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solution designs, configuring and validating Workday Financial and SCM business processes to ensure solutions are accurately built and aligned to client needs. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional and technical teams on design, testing, and integration activities, supporting seamless and effective end\-to\-end delivery.

* Experience in conducting and supporting system testing cycles including SIT and UAT, resolving functional defects, and ensuring solutions meet business requirements.

title: Consultant/Senior Consultant - Finance recruitment group
description:
**Consultant / Senior Consultant – Finance Recruitment Group** 




**Experience: 2–8 years** 




**Locations: Delhi NCR \| Mumbai \| Bengaluru** 




  





*There are recruitment roles where you fill positions. And then there are search roles where you understand businesses, build markets, advise senior leaders, develop relationships and help organisations make important leadership decisions.* 




  





**We are hiring Consultants and Senior Consultants** 
 for Vahura's Finance Recruitment Group.
 



 Our team works across
 **corporates, professional services firms, financial institutions and investment platforms** 
 on finance, tax and audit leadership and specialist mandates spanning CFO and finance leadership, tax partners, Controllership, FP\&A, Treasury, Audit \& Risk, Investor Relations, Corporate Finance, M\&A, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Fund \& Portfolio Operations, Finance Transformation and other specialist finance roles.
 



  





**What will you actually do?** 




  





 You will work across both sides of the market.
 



  





 You will understand an organisation, its business and the leadership problem it is trying to solve; map markets and identify high\-quality professionals; speak with and assess candidates rather than simply screen CVs; manage searches from mandate to closure; build trusted relationships with finance professionals and senior business leaders; and as you grow, originate conversations and develop client relationships of your own.
 



  





 This is a high\-ownership, client\-facing search role rather than a pure sourcing position.
 



  





**Who are we looking for?** 




  





*There are two kinds of people we would particularly like to meet.* 




  





**1\. Recruiters / search professionals** 




 You may already be working with an executive search firm, recruitment consultancy or specialist hiring business and want:
 


* greater ownership of mandates;
* stronger client interaction;
* the opportunity to build a market and relationships rather than just execute searches; and
* a clearer path towards becoming a trusted advisor to clients and professionals.



  





**2\. People looking to move into executive search** 




 You don't necessarily need to have been a recruiter.
 



  





 We would be very interested in speaking with people from B2B/enterprise sales, business development, banking, wealth/private banking, consulting, professional services, client servicing or other relationship\-led commercial roles.
 



  





 If you are good at understanding people, asking intelligent questions, building relationships, influencing decisions and chasing outcomes \- executive search may be a more natural career transition than you think.
 



  





**You will probably enjoy this role if you...** 




  




* are genuinely curious about businesses, careers and people;
* enjoy conversations and relationship building;
* communicate exceptionally well;
* have commercial instinct;
* are comfortable with targets and accountability;
* like figuring things out rather than waiting for instructions; and
* want a career where your network, judgement and market knowledge compound over time.



  





**Why Vahura?** 




  





 Vahura is India’s premier search and management consulting firm, working across legal, finance, HR, compliance, boards and other strategic governance functions.
 



  





 You will join a specialist practice where you can:
 


* work directly on meaningful finance search mandates;
* interact with CFOs, founders, investors, HR leaders and senior functional professionals;
* develop genuine expertise in a market rather than being a generalist recruiter;
* participate in both search execution and business development;
* build a strong professional network across corporate India; and
* progressively take ownership of clients, searches and eventually a market of your own.



  





**Prior finance recruitment experience is useful, but it isn't mandatory. Curiosity, communication, commercial orientation and the ability to build trusted relationships matter enormously to us.**

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description** 
 VVK \& Associates (Chartered Accountants) is a professional services firm dedicated to providing trusted financial expertise and strategic business solutions to organizations, entrepreneurs, and individuals. The firm offers comprehensive services across Taxation, GST compliance, Audit \& Assurance, Accounting, Financial Advisory, and Regulatory Compliance, with a strong emphasis on accuracy, integrity, and timely execution. VVK \& Associates supports clients in navigating complex financial and statutory requirements, helping them operate confidently within evolving regulatory frameworks. The firm is committed to building long\-term relationships through professionalism, transparency, and value\-driven advisory, ensuring that clients receive insightful guidance and practical support. Core services include direct and indirect taxation, GST registration and filing, statutory and internal audits, bookkeeping, business advisory, company law compliance, and financial planning.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Accountant role based in Ghaziabad with VVK \& Associates (Chartered Accountants). The Accountant will be responsible for maintaining accurate books of accounts, preparing financial statements, and handling day\-to\-day accounting entries in accordance with applicable standards. Typical tasks include managing accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, and assisting in tax computations, GST returns, and other statutory filings. The role also involves supporting audit and assurance activities, preparing working papers, and coordinating with seniors to ensure timely completion of compliance and reporting requirements. The Accountant will collaborate with team members to streamline processes, respond to client queries, and contribute to the firm’s commitment to high\-quality, compliant financial practices.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong foundational knowledge of accounting principles, financial statements, and bookkeeping practices.

title: Senior Lead Finance
description:
**About Indus Action \-**
 Indus Action aims to enable over 800 million vulnerable citizens in India to move irreversibly out of extreme poverty by facilitating access to critical government support to which they are entitled. We partner with communities and governments to simplify access to education, livelihoods, healthcare and welfare, using tech and better design to navigate bureaucratic hurdles.
   

  

 By 2030, we aim to impact 30 million people with adequate social protection. Since 2013, our program innovations have impacted 2 million\+ citizens in accessing entitlements across the above workstreams. We are building a diverse, inclusive team that reflects the people we serve because real change needs every voice. Together, we’re making systems work for those who need them most.
   

  

**Position Summary\-**
 We are looking for a Senior Lead Finance who will provide strategic support to program teams in preparing and managing annual budgets with adequate controls, effective monitoring, and reporting. Senior Lead will collaborate and work alongside our existing employees and volunteers in completing the assigned tasks.
   

  

**Role and Responsibilities**
* Ensure the timeliness and accuracy of books of accounts for bookkeeping, payment, auditing, and taxation purposes.
* Closing books of accounts on monthly/quarterly basis ensuring correctness of timely accounting of all relevant transactions, provisions, pre\-paid, depreciation etc.
* Should have complete ownership of all vendor and employee related payments and ensure accuracy and timeliness of all payments.
* To monitor procedures in respect of checking and authorizing accounts for payment, as part of the finance team.
* Review monthly bank reconciliation statements of all bank accounts and update the line manager on its timely compliance.
* To receive and deal with financial queries and enquiries from departments or district offices
* To process Foreign Remittance. Coordinating with bankers for all payments.
* To ensure effective FD management from a cash flow perspective.
* Oversee administrative functions as well as facilities to ensure efficient and consistent operations as the organization scales.
* Monitor year\-end Statutory audit, Income tax Filing and periodic statutory \& legal compliances
* including FCRA returns
* Leading conversations with Banks \& Financial Institutions
* Establish / improve SOPs, Finance policies, and systems to facilitate compliance and effective management of finance function


 Requirements
   

  

**Knowledge and Technical Skills**
* Strong administrative and communication skills
* Confident, self\-driven and a team player
* Self\-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as with a team.
* Prior experience managing employee relation issues within the India country context.
* Resourceful, responsible, and self\-starting
* Ability to manage data efficiently.


**Behavioral Competencies and Values**
* Citizen\-Focused Mindset: Upholding the principle of placing the vulnerable citizen at the center of every initiative
* Entrepreneurial Energy: Showcasing ownership of time and resources to yield solutions
* Dealing with Ambiguity: Maintaining grace under pressure and showcasing a progressive approach
* Growth Mindset: Perceiving every experience as a learning curve and an opportunity for growth
* Collaboration: Cultivating productive partnerships internally and externally.


**Education and Experience \-**
 We believe that reaching our vision demands that we have the best and brightest group of leaders working to lead our organisation. Here are the minimum qualifications we look for:
   

* Minimum educational qualification is Post Graduation with 10\+ years of experience.
* Preference will be given to individuals with prior experience in the non\-profit sector


 Benefits
   

  

 Compensation:
   

 The compensation will be based on the Indus Action‘s compensation benchmarking rubric. The range of compensation will be depending on the qualifications, experience and fit to the role.
   

 The candidate would need to use his/her own laptop and the organization will bear the annual maintenance cost up to INR 12,000 per year as per actuals.
   

  

 Why work with us:
   

 Join a mission that directly impacts millions of lives across India. At our organisation, your work doesn't just improve systems; it transforms how vulnerable citizens and families access the support they deserve. You will be part of a team that has helped millions access their rightful entitlements and aims to reach 30 million people by 2030\. We offer more than just a job; we provide the opportunity to use technology and innovation as tools for social justice. Working alongside diverse communities and state governments, you will help redesign complicated processes into simple, accessible solutions that eliminate barriers to essential services. Indus Action is part of this commitment to create supportive working environments. Employees are expected to the highest standards of ethics in their professional and personal interactions. Indus Action strongly encourages applications from women, persons with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities.

* Define future\-state business and technology capabilities required to support operational and strategic goals.

* Develop and maintain architecture artifacts, process documentation, solution designs, functional specifications, and governance documentation.

* Partner with audit, risk, compliance, and control functions to maintain governance and process integrity across the domain.
* Work closely with Global Process Owners, business leaders, Enterprise Architects, and Value Stream Leads to translate strategic priorities into technology solutions and investment roadmaps.
* Provide architecture guidance and oversight for M\&A activities, business integrations, and enterprise growth initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, architecture patterns, and industry trends to enhance business value and domain capabilities.
* Provide architectural oversight to vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers to ensure alignment with target\-state architecture and technology standards.
* Support strategic technology evaluations, platform selection activities, and major architecture decisions across the Finance domain.

* Proven experience in Domain Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or senior SAP Finance architecture roles within complex global organizations.
* Deep expertise in Finance processes, particularly Record to Report (R2R) and Analyze to Decide (A2D).
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC Finance capabilities, including General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Product Costing, Project Systems, Financial Reporting, Consolidation, and Intercompany Accounting.
* Experience designing and governing enterprise\-scale finance solutions, integrations, and business process transformations.
* Strong understanding of architecture frameworks, governance models, technology roadmaps, and enterprise architecture principles.
* Demonstrated experience defining future\-state business capabilities and translating business strategy into technology solutions.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, governance forums, and strategic technology decision\-making.
* Knowledge of financial governance, regulatory requirements, internal controls, and audit processes within global organizations.
* Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data architecture, and cloud\-enabled enterprise platforms.
* Experience supporting ERP transformation, SAP modernization, acquisition integrations, and business growth initiatives.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, business leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic planning capabilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working with external vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers.

description:
**Position Title:** Accounts Executive / Senior Accounts Executive

**Department:** Finance \& Accounts

**Reports To:** Finance Manager / Senior Accountant / CFO

**Experience Required:** 2 to 3 Years

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented, and self\-motivated **Accounts Executive** with 2–3 years of experience to join our finance team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in managing day\-to\-day accounting functions, ensuring seamless revenue and payment gateway reconciliations, executing end\-to\-end Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) processes, and maintaining statutory tax compliance.

This role requires strong numerical accuracy, proficiency in modern accounting software, and intermediate\-to\-advanced Excel skills to handle multi\-channel financial workflows efficiently.

**Detailed Responsibilities \& Operational Duties1\. General Ledger \& Day\-to\-Day Accounting**

* **Journal Entries \& Postings:** Accurately prepare and record daily accounting transactions, including sales, expenses, cash movements, accrued liabilities, prepaid expenses, and depreciation adjustments.
* **Ledger Hygiene:** Review and sanitize General Ledger (GL) accounts regularly to ensure correct account classifications and prevent misallocations across cost centers.
* **Bank Reconciliation:** Perform weekly and month\-end bank reconciliations across all operational, payroll, and collection accounts. Identify and resolve uncleared deposits, unpresented cheques, direct debits, and bank service charges.
* **Petty Cash Control:** Oversee petty cash disbursements, verify supporting physical vouchers and signatures, reconcile petty cash registers weekly, and process timely replenishment requests.

**2\. Multi\-Channel Sales \& Revenue Reconciliation**

* **Sales Verification:** Reconcile daily point\-of\-sale (POS) reports, billing summaries, and internal ERP sales reports against actual bank credit entries.
* **Payment Gateway \& Merchant Reconciliations:** Perform line\-item reconciliations for settlements received from payment gateways and merchant processors (e.g., Razorpay, Stripe, Paytm, UPI, EDC Card machines).
* **Fee \& Commission Auditing:** Audit and verify processing fees, MDR charges, platform commissions, chargebacks, and holdbacks deducted by financial intermediaries against contracted rate sheets.
* **Dispute Resolution:** Track and resolve un\-reconciled transactions, timing delays, customer chargeback requests, failed payment claims, and refund adjustments.

**3\. Accounts Payable (AP) \& Vendor Management**

* **Invoice Processing:** Receive, digitize, and log incoming vendor bills, utility invoices, service contracts, and material supply invoices.
* **3\-Way Matching:** Perform strict 3\-Way Matching by cross\-referencing Vendor Invoices against approved Purchase Orders (POs) and Goods Received Notes (GRNs) / Service Completion Certificates.
* **Vendor Ledger Maintenance:** Reconcile vendor account statements periodically, address billing discrepancies, track debit notes/credit notes for returned goods, and ensure vendor ledgers are audit\-ready.
* **Payout Management:** Prepare payment proposals and schedules based on agreed credit terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60\), executing payments via online banking channels (NEFT / RTGS / IMPS / Wire transfers).

**4\. Accounts Receivable (AR) \& Credit Management**

* **Invoicing:** Issue tax\-compliant invoices, proforma invoices, and debit/credit notes to B2B and institutional clients.
* **Ageing Analysis \& Follow\-ups:** Maintain and analyze Accounts Receivable ageing reports weekly. Coordinate with clients and internal team leads to secure prompt payments for overdue invoices.
* **Receipt Posting:** Record customer payments, match incoming receipts against outstanding invoice numbers, and process unallocated customer advances.

**5\. Statutory Compliance \& Tax Operations**

* **Tax Invoicing \& Rates:** Ensure accurate tax tagging (GST, Sales Tax, or VAT) on all outgoing invoices and verify tax applicability on incoming vendor bills.
* **GST \& Direct Tax Compliance:**
* Prepare input data, reconciliations (e.g., GSTR\-2B vs. Books comparison), and working sheets for monthly GST returns (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B).
* Calculate monthly Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) liabilities on vendor payments under relevant statutory sections.
* Prepare data for timely tax payments to government portals to avoid interest or penalty levies.
* **Audit Support:** Organize physical and digital document archives (invoices, receipts, tax certificates, bank statements) to assist internal and external auditors during annual financial audits.

**6\. Financial Reporting \& Payroll Support**

* **Month\-End Closing:** Assist senior finance personnel in executing month\-end closing tasks, including posting accrued revenue, prepaid expenses, and provision entries.
* **Trial Balance Finalization:** Help analyze variance in the Trial Balance and resolve unadjusted balances prior to closing monthly accounts.
* **Payroll \& Reimbursements:** Audit monthly employee attendance data, verify advance salary deductions, check employee expense reimbursement claims against receipts, and assist in payroll register posting.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Focus Area**

**Performance Metric / Target**

**Reconciliation Timeliness**

All bank and payment gateway reconciliations completed within 3 business days of month\-end.

**AP Accuracy**

100% compliance with 3\-way matching prior to payment disbursement.

**AR Collections**

Keep overdue receivables (\>60 days) under 5% of total outstanding receivables.

**Tax Compliance**

Zero late fees, interest, or statutory penalty charges due to processing delays.

**Data Integrity**

Zero unallocated or unclassified entries in General Ledger beyond month\-end close.

**Candidate Profile \& Technical Requirements1\. Educational Background**

* **Degree:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or an equivalent discipline. *(Master's degree or partial qualification like Inter CA / CMA is a plus).*

**2\. Experience \& Technical Skills**

* **Core Experience:** Minimum 2 to 3 years of hands\-on experience handling general accounting, AP, AR, and bank reconciliations.
* **Accounting Software:** Advanced working knowledge of accounting software such as **Tally Prime, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or SAP/Oracle Financials**.
* **MS Excel Proficiency:** Intermediate to advanced capabilities in Microsoft Excel, including:
* Pivot Tables \& Data Aggregation
* VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH
* Conditional Formatting \& Data Validation
* Text manipulation and data cleanup tools for large datasets
* **Regulatory Understanding:** Strong understanding of double\-entry bookkeeping principles, basic concepts of revenue recognition, GST structures, and TDS deduction rules.

**3\. Behavioral \& Professional Attributes**

* **Attention to Detail:** Meticulous approach to verifying numbers and resolving balance discrepancies.
* **Problem\-Solving Skills:** Ability to trace transaction errors across banking statements, billing tools, and ledger accounts.
* **Communication:** Clear oral and written communication for liaising with vendors, corporate customers, and banking partners.
* **Time Management:** Ability to prioritize time\-sensitive tasks during peak periods like month\-end closing and tax payment dates.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

title: Head of Finance
description:
About the Job

Pragyan Impact Solutions works with governments, nonprofits, communities, and institutions across India to turn ambitious goals into measurable outcomes, through strategic advisory, program design, technology\-driven execution, and capacity building in governance and development.

Experience:

8–14 years, including demonstrated ownership of finance strategy (not just finance execution) for at least one growing organization or business unit. Note: Title will be calibrated to experience and demonstrated scope: Head of Finance, AVP/VP – Finance.

Role Description

We're looking for someone to own the financial strategy and capital planning function of the organization, effectively acting as the finance partner to the founder/CEO, across our consulting \& research division and our communications division (potentially extending to affiliated entities or sister ventures). You'll sit close to leadership, shape how the business allocates capital, and be the person the founder turns to before a strategic decision rather than after it.

Qualifications

**8\+ years in progressively senior finance roles, with at least 2\-3 years owning financial strategy, forecasting, or capital decisions, not just accounting execution**  Strong grounding in financial modeling, scenario planning, unit economics, and cash flow forecasting for a project/consulting\-revenue business **Experience managing statutory compliance, audits, and regulatory relationships (GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, income tax, ROC/company law basics)**  Working knowledge of contracts, MoUs, and commercial terms, able to review and negotiate, not just file **Demonstrated experience building or scaling a finance function: designing the systems, not just running them**  CA / MBA (Finance) strongly preferred; CFA or equivalent a plus **Prior exposure to consulting, government/development\-sector, or multi\-vertical service businesses is a strong plus**  Comfortable operating with founder\-level ambiguity; priorities will shift, and you're expected to bring structure to that, not wait for it

Key Responsibilities

1\. Financial Strategy \& Business Partnering **Own annual budgeting, financial planning, and multi\-year forecasting across divisions (and across entities, if scope extends to sister ventures)**  Build the financial case for new business lines, tenders, and pricing decisions: model margins on project bids before they're submitted, not after **Act as thought partner to the founder/CEO on capital allocation, hiring plans, and investment decisions**  Own cash flow strategy and working capital management across long\-cycle government/institutional payment timelines **Prepare board\-/founder\-level financial narratives, not just numbers, but what they mean and what to do about them 2\. Finance \& Accounting Oversight**  Own the finance function end\-to\-end: AP, AR, general ledger, monthly and annual close, reviewed and signed off by you **Own preparation and integrity of financial statements (P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and present these to leadership**  Set and enforce financial controls, approval hierarchies, and delegation of authority across the org **Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors, and legal counsel; own the audit process end\-to\-end, not just coordinate it 3\. MIS, Reporting \& Decision Support**  Design and own the MIS architecture: what gets tracked, at what frequency, and for whom **Deliver monthly and quarterly business reviews with budget\-vs\-actual analysis, variance drivers, and recommended actions**  Build project\-level and division\-level profitability views (a critical gap in most consulting businesses) so leadership knows which engagements actually make money **Build dashboards and reporting systems that scale, not one\-off Excel files that break when someone leaves 4\. Compliance, Risk \& Governance**  Own statutory compliance strategy across GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, and any entity\-level regulatory requirements; team executes, you're accountable **Own contract review and risk flagging on client MoUs, vendor agreements, and consortium/JV arrangements (e.g., sub consultancy structures)**  Build and maintain a compliance calendar and risk register for the organization **Represent the organization in front of auditors, regulators, and institutional client finance teams when needed 5\. People \& Payroll Strategy**  Own payroll strategy and compensation structuring (not just processing) in coordination with HR/leadership **Build and lead the finance team: hire, train, and manage as the function scales 6\. Cross\-Entity / Multi\-Business Financial Oversight (if scope extends beyond one entity)**  Provide consolidated financial oversight across 2\-3 affiliated entities or business lines, with entity\-level P\&Ls rolling up to a consolidated view **Standardize financial processes and controls across entities so each isn't reinventing its own system**  Flag and manage inter\-entity transactions and shared cost allocation

What Success Looks Like

**Leadership makes capital and hiring decisions with real financial data in hand, not gut calls**  The org knows which projects and divisions are actually profitable **Compliance and audits run on a calendar, not on adrenaline**  Cash flow is forecast, not discovered **Finance is treated as a strategic function in the room, not a back\-office function reporting out of it**  The founder can hand you a hard financial problem and walk away, confident it'll be handled

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Finance Analyst
description:
The Finance Analyst will provide comprehensive financial and analytical support for a Facilities Management client account within JLL's Real Estate Management Services (REMS) division. This role focuses on day\-to\-day financial operations including transaction processing, MIS reporting, variance analysis, and client billing support. The Finance Analyst will work closely with client finance teams, JLL operations personnel, and the Finance Manager to ensure accurate financial reporting, timely invoicing, and effective financial controls for the account.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Financial Reporting \& MIS**
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for the client account
* Generate Management Information System (MIS) reports, dashboards, and analytical summaries for internal and external stakeholders
* Maintain and update financial trackers, reconciliations, and supporting documentation
* Ensure timely and accurate financial close processes


**Variance Analysis \& Performance Tracking**
* Conduct detailed variance analysis comparing actuals against budgets and forecasts
* Identify trends, anomalies, and cost drivers impacting financial performance
* Prepare commentary and explanations for variances to support management review
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics relevant to the client account


**Budgeting \& Forecasting Support**
* Assist in the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts
* Gather inputs from operations teams and consolidate financial data for planning processes
* Update forecast models based on actual performance and business changes
* Support scenario analysis and what\-if modeling exercises


**Client Billing \& Invoicing**
* Coordinate client billing activities, ensuring accurate and timely invoice generation
* Review billing data for completeness and accuracy before client submission
* Liaise with client finance teams to resolve billing queries and disputes
* Track invoice status, payment collections, and accounts receivable aging


**Stakeholder Coordination \& Client Engagement**
* Serve as a finance point of contact for day\-to\-day client inquiries and requests
* Coordinate with external client finance teams on routine financial matters, data requests, and reporting schedules
* Work collaboratively with JLL operations teams to gather information and resolve financial issues
* Participate in client review meetings and present financial reports as needed


**Transaction Processing \& Data Management**
* Process financial transactions in ERP systems with accuracy and adherence to controls
* Maintain data integrity across financial systems and databases
* Perform account reconciliations and support month\-end close activities
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies and client\-specific requirements


**Process Improvement \& Automation**
* Identify opportunities to streamline reporting processes and improve efficiency

title: Financial Oversight Specialist
description:
Business Introduction
   

  

 At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R\&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting\-edge technology to transform people’s lives. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
   

  

 Find out more:
   

  

 Our approach to R\&D
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 You will manage financial controls, Purchase order oversight, and reporting to support better decision making for R\&D services . You will work closely with finance, procurement, and technology partners to ensure accurate financial records and timely insights. We value people who are curious, collaborative, and committed to high quality work. This role offers growth through exposure to enterprise systems, cross\-functional projects, and work that directly supports our mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
   

  

 Responsibilities:

* Maintain and review financial records, reconciliations, and month\-end close activities to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Prepare clear financial summaries, variance analyses, and management reports for stakeholders, with a focus on purchase orders and invoices.
* Partner with Procurement and Category teams to validate spend, contracts, and supplier financial data.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and cost monitoring projects with timely data and insights.
* Help improve financial controls, processes, and documentation to reduce risk and increase efficiency.


 Why You?
   

  

 We are looking for someone who will bring care, clarity, and focus to our financial oversight. You will have the chance to shape processes, coach colleagues, and grow into broader finance or business partnership roles. You will be part of an inclusive team that values learning and respectful collaboration. This position is located in India and is on\-site with hybrid working options as defined by the local team and role needs.
   

  

 Basic Qualification
   

  

 We are seeking professionals with the following skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field
* Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, audit, or procurement finance
* Strong Excel skills and experience working with financial systems/ERPs

 What success looks like
   

  

 You will be successful when financial records are accurate, reports are clear and on time, and stakeholders trust your analysis. You will make measurable improvements to controls and reporting. You will help teams make better decisions through clear financial insight.
   

  

 How to apply

title: Senior FinOps Analyst
description:
Sapiens is on the lookout for a Senior FinOps Analyst sits within the Cloud Services Office (CSO) – FinOps \& Demand Management function, reporting to the Director of FinOps. This is a critical, data\-driven role responsible for governing cloud financial performance, enabling demand transparency, and driving cost optimisation across the organisation. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of finance, technology, and business operations — ensuring cloud investments are aligned, accountable, and delivering measurable value.
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Working Model: Our flexible work arrangement combines both remote and in\-office work, optimizing flexibility and productivity.
   

  

 This position will be part of Sapiens CTO – Cloud Services division, for more information about it, click here: www.sapiens.com .
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**FinOps Governance \& Cloud Cost Management**
* Lead cloud financial governance — owning cost visibility, optimisation, forecasting, anomaly detection, and accountability for cloud spend across all business units.
* Maintain and enforce FinOps policies, standards, and controls to ensure financial discipline in cloud consumption.
* Proactively identify cost inefficiencies, overspend, and waste — and drive actionable remediation with engineering and operations teams.
* Target performance: ≤±5% variance from approved budget and ≥10–15% annual cost optimisation year\-over\-year.


 Demand Management \& Capacity Forecasting
   

  

* Define and lead the demand intake process — ensuring alignment between business priorities, resource requests, and cloud execution capacity.
* Assess and prioritise demand items within SLA (≤5–10 business days from intake to prioritisation decision), with ≥95% of items formally assessed and tracked.
* Collaborate with engineering and operations leads to align capacity planning with strategic demand signals.
* Provide data\-driven forecasting to inform resource allocation decisions and avoid under\- or over\-provisioning.


 Reporting \& Executive Insights
   

  

* Produce and maintain monthly FinOps reports — covering cloud spend, budget variance, forecast accuracy, and optimisation progress — for executive leadership and C\-suite stakeholders.
* Design and manage dashboards and reporting cadences that give real\-time visibility into financial and demand performance.
* Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, executive\-appropriate narratives and recommendations.
* Support the Head of CSO in quarterly transformation milestone reviews and board\-level reporting as required.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact between the CSO team and Finance (P\&L), engineering leads, and operations stakeholders on all matters of cloud cost and demand.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across all SCS internal teams, ensuring consumption decisions are financially sound and operationally viable.
* Facilitate regular demand reviews (weekly cadence) and FinOps governance meetings, ensuring actions are tracked and owners are accountable.
* Contribute to the broader transformation and continuous improvement agenda within the CSO team.


**Must Have Skills**
**What to Have for this position.**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FinOps Foundation) preferred; cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP) are a strong advantage.


 Professional Experience
   

  

* 4–7 years of experience in FinOps, cloud financial management, or a related function within a technology or cloud\-native environment.
* Demonstrated track record of cloud cost optimisation, with measurable outcomes and a focus on budget adherence.
* Experience with demand management, resource planning, or operational governance in a cloud services context.
* Proven ability to produce executive\-level financial and operational reporting for senior stakeholders.
* Familiarity with FinOps tooling (e.g. CloudHealth, Apptio, Cloudability, AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management).


**Skills \& Core Competencies**
**Personal \& Interpersonal Technical \& Delivery**
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail
* Cloud cost management \& optimisation
* Strong communicator — able to translate financial data into business language
* Demand and capacity forecasting
* Collaborative across engineering, finance, and operations teams
* Budget management \& variance analysis
* Proactive and self\-driven with high accountability
* FinOps governance and financial controls
* Resilient under pressure with ability to manage competing priorities
* Dashboard design and executive reporting
* Influencing without direct authority across stakeholder groups
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP cost tools
* Tooling: CloudHealth, Apptio, Cloudability, or similar


**Personal Attributes**
 The Ideal Candidate Is More Than An Analyst — They Are a Proactive Financial Steward And Demand Coordinator Who Can Be Counted On To Bring Rigour, Clarity, And Accountability To Cloud Operations. We Are Looking For Someone With
   

  

* A data\-first mindset — naturally drawn to numbers, trends, and root\-cause analysis, with the confidence to challenge spend decisions based on evidence.
* A bias for action — someone who surfaces issues early, escalates with clear recommendations, and does not wait to be told.
* Exceptional organisational discipline — able to manage multiple reporting cycles, stakeholder demands, and governance processes without dropping the ball.
* A collaborative, influential style — able to work across finance, engineering, and business teams without direct authority.
* Strong ownership mentality — takes personal responsibility for the accuracy, timeliness, and impact of their work.
* A calm, composed presence — able to handle ambiguity and pressure while maintaining the confidence of senior stakeholders.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within the first 6 months, the Senior FinOps Analyst will be expected to:
   

  

 1 Establish full visibility of cloud spend across all business units, with a baseline cost model and variance tracking in place.
   

  

 2 Deliver the first monthly FinOps report to executive leadership — clear, accurate, and decision\-ready.
   

  

 3 Implement a demand intake and prioritisation process that meets the ≤5–10 day SLA for assessment and decision.
   

  

 4 Identify and drive at least one meaningful cost optimisation initiative contributing to the annual 10–15% savings target.
   

  

 5 Be regarded as the go\-to person for cloud cost transparency, demand data, and FinOps governance within the CSO team.
   

  

**AI Expectations**
* Basic understanding of Generative AI and LLMs, including practical use cases for improving productivity and business operations.
* Experience using AI\-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to automate reporting, analyze data, summarize insights, and improve operational efficiency.
* Ability to leverage AI for FinOps activities, such as cloud cost analysis, anomaly detection, forecasting, budget optimization, and executive reporting.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, and appropriate use of AI when handling enterprise financial and operational data.


**About Sapiens**

title: Manager - Revenue Operations & Commercial Finance
description:
**About the role** 




 Mareana builds AI\-powered data platforms for life sciences and advanced manufacturing. We do complex, enterprise deals. These are high\-value long\-term contracts with a small number of strategically important customers. That means every deal matters individually, and the commercial machinery behind it has to be precise rather than high\-volume.
 



  





 This role owns that machinery. You will sit between Sales, Legal, Delivery and Finance, running the contracting workflow, the deal desk, commissions, and bookings reporting, and will use the same data to support revenue forecasting and management reporting.
 



  





 It is deliberately a hybrid role: part revenue operations, part commercial finance. You will be the single person who can answer both "what did we book?" and "what does that mean for revenue, margin and cash?" You will work directly with the Senior Director of Finance, with visibility to the CFO and the leadership team.
 



  





**What you will own** 




**Customer contracting** 



* Draft, review and negotiate MSAs, NDAs and SOWs alongside Legal and Sales
* Run the contract redlining and internal approval workflow, keeping cycle times predictable
* Manage the full contract lifecycle: renewals, amendments and terminations
* Prepare order forms and pricing schedules
* Maintain the contract repository and track contractual obligations, milestones and key dates



  





**Sales operations** 



* Design the annual sales commission plan with Finance and Sales leadership
* Run monthly commission calculation and administration
* Reconcile sales compensation and resolve disputes
* Provide deal desk support: pricing approvals, non\-standard terms and exception handling
* Perform deal\-level margin analysis, both pre\-signature and post\-delivery
* Track bookings (TCV / ACV) by rep, segment and product line
* Own quote\-to\-cash and order processing, working with Billing and Delivery
* Build and maintain sales reporting and dashboards — pipeline, KPIs, win/loss
* Administer the CRM and enforce data hygiene as the commercial system of record
* Track renewals and upsell / expansion opportunities



  





**Commercial Finance** 



* Support the rolling revenue forecast, including pipeline\-weighted and probability\-adjusted models
* Maintain Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and bookings reporting, and reconcile it to the P\&L
* Prepare commercial inputs for monthly management reporting and board materials
* Perform variance analysis on bookings, revenue and sales cost against plan
* Support revenue recognition for subscription and services contracts
* Model commission and pricing scenarios and their P\&L impact



  





**What we are looking for** 




**Must have** 



* 5\-7 years in revenue operations, sales operations, commercial finance or business finance, ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS or a technology services business
* Hands\-on ownership of at least one full commission cycle and one bookings / ARR reporting cycle
* Working fluency in a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot), not just a consumer of reports. The ability to build reports, fix data and design a workflow
* Strong commercial contract literacy. Experience with MSA or SOW, including understanding what drives revenue timing, margin and risk
* Genuine financial competence. Advanced Excel, comfort with revenue recognition principles, and the ability to build a forecast model from first principles
* Clear written and verbal communication and the confidence to say no to a poor deal structure



  





**Good to have** 



* Exposure to CPQ, contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools, or revenue intelligence platforms such as Clari or Gong.
* Experience in a business with long enterprise sales cycles and a small number of high\-value logos
* Familiarity with professional services delivery and time\-and\-materials or milestone\-based billing and profitability/resource utilization analysis.
* CA, MBA (Finance), CMA or equivalent — useful, but not required where the practical experience is there
* Exposure to US GAAP or ASC 606



  





**What will make you successful here** 



* Comfort operating as an individual contributor with wide scope. This is a build role, not a maintain role, as many of the processes are yet\-to\-be\-developed.
* Judgement over process adherence. With a small deal count, the right answer usually requires thought rather than a playbook
* Willingness to work across time zones with the US commercial team



  





**Why this role is worth taking** 



* Full\-stack commercial ownership. Most people in this space get either the CRM or the model. Here you get both, plus contracting.
* Direct access to the CFO, Senior Director of Finance, and senior Sales and Delivery leaders, with visibility into board\-level reporting
* Real influence on how the commercial function is built, at a stage where the decisions are still being made
* A clear path into a broader commercial finance or revenue operations leadership role as the business scales

title: Cost Engineering Manager
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
   

  

 As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
   

  

 What You Can Expect
   

  

 The Cost Engineering Manager plays a critical role in estimating, budgeting, and developing cost insights into direct and indirect products and services. Using engineering principles and input costs as the basis, the Cost Engineering Manager develops cost models, tracks spending, identifies savings, and provides financial reports to stakeholders, acting as a crucial financial navigator for technical projects and negotiations.
   

  

 Work Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days in office)
   

  

 How You'll Create Impact
   

  

* Develop cost models and detailed cost break up for product, services with detailed insights into labor, materials, transportation and overhead cost buckets.
* Use raw materials standard market bench marking, manufacturing processes costs including capital equipment, consumables, utilities and other investments, overheads, labor, and transportation services.
* Identify opportunities for cost improvement with external suppliers and service partners and develop broad road maps for product/service costs along with commercial and contractual terms including costs. Develop zero\-based costing or “Should Costing” for Zimmer Biomet products and services that can become reference costs for product launch, negotiations, and product pricing.
* Build dashboards and models to track Cost Model development and “Should Cost” progress.
* Develop market intelligence for competitive products, develop cost models from tear down, and re\-engineering for competition products.
* Develop Zimmer Biomet products benchmark costing for products and services based on competition and industry trends.
* Develop data analytics for commodity costs databases, trend trackers, labor markets costs data models for each region and freight, logistics costs models for Zimmer Biomet products, and services.
* Develop, deploy, and document cost management standards, procedures, and templates for using across organizations globally.
* Partner with Category Managers, Legal, and Finance to prepare for high\-impact negotiations.
* Collaborate with Finance for product costs roll ups and budgeting.
* Support automation and digital tools that enhance cost engineering efficiency and transparency.
* Ensure cost engineering practices align with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation and audit trails for strategic negotiations.
* Prepare reports, presentations, business communications, data summaries, and other documents of both a recurring and nonrecurring nature.
* Create reports to show financial impact of procurement projects and initiatives.
* Perform moderately complex analyses of data to draw inferences or conclusions to drive sound decisions.
* Collaborate actively with key stakeholders to ensure Procurement is actively engaged at the beginning of the process in core business initiatives and processes.


 What Makes You Stand Out
   

  

* “Should Costing” development for major cost driver products and services.
* The Cost Engineering Manager will be actively involved in Negotiation Excellence with Supply partners, with new product development teams for developing new products, and with Procurement for current revenue products.
* The relationship between this role, Procurement senior leadership, Procurement team members, and cross\-functional stakeholders will be working well with no confusion regarding roles and responsibilities.
* Well\-defined competition, industry, and market benchmarks for Zimmer Biomet products.
* Data analytics available in the form of Power BI and/or reports for various commodity trends, labor, and freight markets applied to Zimmer Biomet products with agility for changing and dynamic markets.
* Well\-defined Cost Models at Zimmer Biomet Procurement Leadership level, Category level, and at key supplier level as well as sharing with suppliers to challenge status quo costs for cost productivity.
* Performance internal metrics and supporting data collection processes will be actively monitored and viewed as credible and accurate.


 Your Background
   

  

**Technical Skills**
* Cost Engineering / Should Costing
* Cost modeling (Cost Estimation, Product Costing, Cost Analysis, Cost Reduction, Margin Analysis, Conversion Cost, Overheads / Labor Costing)
* Supplier costing \& negotiations
* Experience in Procurement / sourcing / supply chain combined with costing expertise
* Knowledge of Manufacturing processes, Cost structures \& industry standards \& Labor, overheads, conversion cost calculations
* Experience working on Costing Software – Any like A\-Priori, FACTON EPC Suite, Microsoft excel based Costing templates, Teamcenter Cost management etc


**Expected Areas Of Competence (i.e., Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities)**
* Knowledge of Mechanical and/or electronics manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Manufacturing costs, industry standards, regulations.
* Knowledge of costing methodologies, taxation, and transportation costs with understanding of overheads and capex impact on product costings.
* End to End understanding of commercial and contractual terms and its impact on product/service costs.
* Strong behavioral aspects such as collaboration, ability to challenge, deal\-making, and ability to find win\-win solutions with active listening and attention to details.
* Strong analytical skills. Attention to details and the ability to connect dots.
* Strong track record in Procurement, Category Management, and Contract Management.
* Ability to engage and influence and facilitate internal business partners and team members at all levels of the organization. Ability to establish relationships quickly with a broad range of constituents. Must possess a collaborative style to work effectively throughout the organization.
* Excellent written, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences at various organizational levels.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office and related software. Strong skills in working with Excel, database software, Costing software like a\-Priori or FACTON EPC suite, BI tools (Power BI, Tableau), ERP systems (specifically SAP), and statistics.
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Demonstrated history of taking initiative, meeting commitments, and assisting in the creation of new tools or solutions to achieve business results.
* Proven track record of effective process management and improvement.
* Ability to tolerate ambiguity, handle multiple priorities, and identify creative solutions to problems.
* Financial acumen with a solid understanding of common financial statements.
* High level of personal accountability and integrity.
* Energetic and driven to successfully reach objectives
* Proficient with and/or the ability to quickly learn Zimmer Biomet’s systems.
* Knowledge of functional best practices, industry trends, legal and regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electronics Engineering (with Master’s Degree preferred supply chain, Economics, Business, Finance, or a related field).
* At least ten years of progressive experience in Procurement, Sourcing, or Supply Chain analytics required.
* Experienced in managing large, complex, and global environments and suppliers in diverse cultural environments.
* Understanding of Procurement best practices, contract law, and supplier risk management.
* Strong track record in Procurement, Category Management, Contract Management, and Negotiation.
* Professional, related certification is preferred.


 Travel Expectations
   

  

 Must possess the ability to travel on a regular basis with overnight stays up to 20%. Occasional global travel may be required.
   

  

 EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK

 We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced General Ledger (GL) Accountant to join the new R2R team being established within our India Delivery Centre (IDC). The GL Accountant will report directly to the R2R Manager and will take ownership of General Ledger accounting processes covering Version 1's UK, Ireland and US entities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical competence, work accurately and efficiently to tight month end deadlines, and take genuine ownership of their processes. The GL Accountant will play a key role in building a high performing GL function within the IDC.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**General Ledger Operations**
* Process and review journal entries in accordance with approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Maintain accurate and timely financial records across multiple entities and currencies (UK, Ireland and US)
* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and maintain bank accounts including bank reconciliation
* Fixed assets accounting including registration, capitalisation, depreciation, and disposals
* Monitor the accuracy and appropriateness of allocations across cost centres
* Prepare and post journal entries with full supporting documentation
* Execute month end close activities including accruals, prepayments, and intercompany reconciliations
* Resolve reconciling items within agreed timelines
* Perform closing and consolidation activities including period end close, consolidation journal entries, and preparation of trial balance
* Perform closing department checks in accordance with the month end close timetable
* Preparation of financial inputs to monthly management accounts
* Support annual financial statements preparation and year end close activities
* Perform intercompany journal entries and intercompany balance reconciliations
* Apply all controls consistently and escalate any deviation, system issue, or exception immediately to the R2R Manager


**Process Compliance and Quality**
* Follow approved SOPs precisely at all times and support continuous improvement by identifying inefficiencies and raising recommendations to the R2R Manager
* Maintain quality standards and turnaround times agreed between the IDC and the onshore Finance team
* Support the R2R Manager in monitoring process performance and flagging risks to the GPO Lead


**Knowledge Transfer and Collaboration**
* Actively participate in process walkthroughs, observation sessions, and supervised practice during the knowledge transfer period
* Build effective working relationships with Finance colleagues and stakeholders as directed by the R2R Manager, supporting seamless day\-to\-day operations


**Systems and Reporting**
* Prepare reports and reconciliation schedules as required by the R2R Manager and onshore Finance team
* Support internal and external audits by preparing schedules, providing documentation, and responding to queries


**Qualifications**
* Part\-qualified or newly qualified accountant — CA (ICAI), CMA (ICMAI), or ACCA preferred. The target profile is a CA finalist or newly qualified CA with 3 to 4 years of post\-articleship experience in a shared service or GL environment, within an overall experience range of 3 to 6 years
* Proven, independent ownership of month end close processes — journal preparation, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and intercompany accounting — executed to deadline without supervision
* Solid understanding of IFRS accounting standards
* Hands\-on experience with NetSuite ERP system or a comparable enterprise ERP (SAP, Oracle)
* Proficiency in MS Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and reconciliation tools
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English — essential for working with onshore Finance teams in the UK and Ireland
* Experience in a Shared Services Centre, Finance Operations team, or offshore delivery environment is required
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and ability to work to tight month end deadlines
* Proactive and results\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability


**Additional Information**
 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
   

  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits

* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
